bullets.text: Sage Boosts SMB Digitalisation - **Sage** acquires **Akao** to enhance digital solutions for small and medium businesses.
Sage Copilot: AI for Finance - **Sage Copilot** integrates AI into finance operations, enhancing security and efficiency.
Guide to MTD for Income Tax - **Sage** offers a free e-book on transitioning to **Making Tax Digital** for Income Tax.
Mental Health in Accountancy - Accountants must manage stress during the **MTD** roll-out to protect their well-being.
Holiday Entitlement Simplified - **Sage** provides a calculator to help businesses accurately determine employee holiday entitlements.
